userGroups.title: User Groups
userGroups.description: Named, role-scoped presets of Menu Access and System Functions settings. Assign a group to a user and its settings apply automatically — edit the group later and every member follows. Per-user overrides on top of the group still work.
userGroups.noGroups: No user groups yet. Create one to preset Menu Access and System Functions for similar users.

addModal.title: Add User Group
addModal.name: Name
addModal.rolePlaceholder: Select the role this group applies to
addModal.roleHint: The role is fixed after creation — a group only ever applies to users of this role.

details.title: User Group
details.viewerHint: Viewer group — every module and function starts blocked; the settings you enable here are GRANTED to members.
details.executiveHint: Executive group — everything starts available; the settings you disable here are hidden from members.
details.liveHint: Changes apply to all members on their next sign-in or refresh. Per-user overrides on the User Details page take precedence over the group.
details.menuHint: Which sidebar modules members of this group can see (the tenant-wide Menu Settings remain the ceiling).
details.sysFnHint: Which action buttons members of this group can use.
details.membersHint: Users assigned to this group. A group cannot be deleted while it has members.
details.noMembers: No members yet. Assign users from the User Details page or when creating a user.
details.deleteBlockedMsg: This group still has {{count}} member(s). Reassign or clear them before deleting the group.
details.deleteConfirmMsg: Delete the group "{{name}}"? Its menu and function settings will be removed.

menu.title: Menu Settings

appConfig.title: System Configuration
appConfig.description: Runtime settings for this deployment, stored in the database and overriding the .env defaults. Secret values are encrypted at rest and never shown after saving. Changes apply live, except keys marked "Restart required", which are read at boot and only take effect after the API is restarted.
appConfig.confirmChangeMessage: Update "{{name}}"? The change applies live unless this key requires a restart.
appConfig.confirmResetMessage: Reset "{{name}}" to its default value? Any custom override will be removed.

auth.logoutConfirm: Are you sure you want to logout?

settlements.cancelMessage: Cancel settlement #{{id}}? This releases its in-flight cover; nothing has moved off-chain.

positions.title: Net Positions
positions.description: Running signed net per counterparty entity and currency - every cross-entity credit move lands here as a fiat obligation.

obligations.title: Obligations
obligations.description: Per-transaction fiat obligations derived from cross-entity credit moves (plus declared and claimed IOUs).

list.title: Settlements
list.description: Net settlements between entity pairs. The debtor confirms the wire was sent; the creditor confirms receipt - only then does the net decrease.

createModal.title: Create Settlement
createModal.subtitle: Debtor-side: propose settling part of the net you owe a counterparty. The amount is locked as in-flight cover until confirmed or cancelled.

sentModal.title: Confirm Funds Sent
sentModal.receiptNote: Pinned as an encrypted document shared with the counterparty and both regulators; only its CID goes on-chain.

receivedModal.title: Confirm Funds Received
receivedModal.warning: Confirming receipt permanently reduces the net position between the two entities on-chain. Only confirm after verifying the funds arrived.

distribution.acceptMessage: Accept distributing {{asset}} through {{service}}? Your service will front redemption payouts from its own liquidity and be reimbursed by the issuer through the obligations ledger.

agreements.title: Distribution Agreements
agreements.description: Assets registered on your services by their issuers. Accepting is required before the regulator can activate the agreement.

trades.title: Primary-Market Trades
trades.description: Subscribe / redeem trades on this tenant’s assets and services - including trades on your assets executed by foreign distributors.

dexOfferings.title: DEX Offerings
dexOfferings.description: Primary issuance on a venue (IPO facility): standing tap offers at a fixed price, approved per-offering by the asset’s regulator.
dexOfferings.createdMessage: The offering was created and is pending approval by the asset’s regulator.
dexOfferings.cancelMessage: Cancel this offering? Any escrowed reserve is released and no further fills are possible.

createModal.title: Create Offering
createModal.subtitle: Standing tap: buyers fill at a fixed price directly against the issuer’s reserve. Venue fees are frozen into the offering at creation.
createModal.noVenues: No regulator-approved venue pairings for this asset - add the asset to a venue and get the pairing approved first.
createModal.note: Requires regulator approval before going live. Fixed-supply assets escrow the offered amount from the reserve.
